snippet.title: Damnation84 - Playtest Trailer
snippet.description:
Damnation84 is a fast-paced FPS game that uses impulse and propulsion weapons as a means of movement and combat.
In this devastated world, eliminate enemies in sequence and complete the levels before your oxygen runs out. 
You are the last hope, survive and cause damnation.

PLAYTEST available on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4418990/Damnation84/

Be sure to wishlist it.
